facts.claim: ARCO identifies three designated accessible parking spaces beside its main parking-lot entrance. Bay measurements and the complete bay-to-door route are unconfirmed.
facts.quote: When entering the ARCO parking lot, you can find 3 ADA spaces next to the main parking lot entrance.

facts.claim: Wheelchair entry is through the west door or adjacent first-floor north doors only. ARCO explicitly says the second-floor balcony is not wheelchair accessible.
quote: ARCO is accessible for persons using wheelchairs by the west door or adjacent 1st floor north doors only.
The second-floor balcony is not wheelchair accessible.

facts.claim: The venue describes an elevator serving four floors and the lower basement. This does not remove the separate second-floor balcony restriction.
facts.quote: ARCO's elevator runs through all 4 floors of ARCO and the lower level basement.

facts.claim: ARCO says there is no first-floor restroom; other restrooms are reached using the west-wing elevator. Confirm lift operation and the route before attending.
facts.quote: While there is no restroom on the 1st floor of ARCO, you can access all restrooms via the elevator in the west wing of the building.

facts.claim: ARCO describes its restrooms as accessible with one stall each, and baby changing stations in all restrooms. Detailed fittings and adult changing equipment are unconfirmed.
quote: Restrooms at ARCO are ADA accessible with one stall per restroom.
All restrooms have baby changing stations.

facts.claim: The venue says wayfinding signs throughout the building include Spanish and Braille. It does not document hearing assistance or tactile coverage beyond these signs.
facts.quote: Wayfinding signs can be found throughout ARCO. These signs have also been translated into Spanish and Braille.

facts.claim: ARCO lists a wheelchair available on site. Availability, dimensions and any staff assistance need confirming.
facts.quote: ARCO has a wheelchair available on site.

facts.claim: ARCO encourages renters to designate a gender-neutral restroom and offers signs for that purpose. The arrangement depends on the event.
facts.quote: we encourage renters to choose a restroom to designate as gender-neutral, at which time ARCO can provide you with the appropriate signs.

facts.claim: The access page welcomes trained service animals. Ask the venue about any event-specific arrival arrangements.
facts.quote: ARCO welcomes all those with trained service animals to use our facility.
